source: Doubao visible task responses and local execution states

cases.name: content infringement rejection from screenshot
cases.text: 生成内容中疑似包含侵权 / 违规内容，无法返回该内容，换个主题再试试，生成额度未扣除。

cases.name: unsafe prompt rejection
cases.text: 该提示词存在敏感风险，不符合平台规范，请修改后重试。

cases.name: reference asset rejected
cases.text: 上传图片包含违规内容，素材无法处理，请更换图片。

cases.name: unsupported duration
cases.text: 当前模型不支持该视频时长，请调整参数。

cases.name: login expired
cases.text: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录后再试。

cases.name: generic provider failure returned after generation submission
cases.text: 出了点问题，请稍后重试。

cases.name: explicit generation failure
cases.text: 本次视频生成失败，请检查描述后重试。

cases.name: non-standard terminal failure
cases.text: 这次没有生成出来，你可以修改描述后重新生成。

cases.name: generation stopped without standard error code
cases.text: 视频生成已停止，请调整素材后重新生成。

cases.name: quota exhausted
cases.text: 今日视频生成免费次数用完，请明天再试。

cases.name: normal generating response
cases.text: 视频生成已提交，预计等待 5 分钟。

handling.content_policy: release account, preserve original task, require prompt edit, create and run a child task
handling.asset_policy: release account, preserve original task, require asset removal or replacement
handling.parameters: release account, preserve original task, require model/ratio/duration change
handling.authentication: release account, require login, then create and run a child task
handling.transient_provider: release account and allow a deliberate later retry
handling.provider_generation: release account and allow retry because provider returned a terminal failure
handling.quota: release current account and fail over; wait until Asia/Shanghai midnight when all candidates are exhausted
handling.submission_unknown: do not release for automatic reuse and never resubmit automatically
handling.result_download: keep the submitted task and retry only result recovery/download, never regenerate
